cause_quote: The initial relay wrapper created `AbortSignal.timeout(15_000)` for submission and passed it to `boundRequest`, leaving the timer armed after the Gateway accepted the run.
user_saw: An MCP reply that was still making progress was cancelled about 15 seconds after submission.
summary: The MCP relay now clears the submission deadline when the Gateway request settles.
reasoning: The introducing commit added both relay submission paths and applied the same 15-second deadline to each. I checked Gateway ingress at that commit and confirmed it already passed the request signal into the authority captured for accepted work, so the deadline could cancel a run from the feature's first version.
